scope: Exact monitor extracted from TV tool; virtual clock/video/counters; no TV, build or platform decoder

results.name: initial observation does not count existing cumulative frames
repeated snapshots count only frame differences
over-three-second gap retains buffer state and nearby event evidence
advancing closes the original gap without creating duplicates
natural loop splits segments even when ended was sampled earlier
counter reset opens a segment without summing cumulative frame counts
unavailable counters remain null and explicitly incomplete
cleanup removes every listener, timer and monitor ownership
